title: iana_charsets: Redefine the basic macro of iana charsets for adding a shorter iana enum_val_t array to display popup menu friendly and simplying maintenance mapping of iana_enum to wireshark enconding
description:
# Background and Solution

After !10021 is merged, I found the iana charsets enum list of 'Default character encoding' preference looks ok in preferences window:

![xml_default_encoding_in_preference_win](/uploads/3f66e327c9c1d70e7a36ad6a1b383688/XML_charset_preference.png)

But if you try to configure the preference by the right click popup menu, it does not look good because the iana list has too many items: 

![xml_default_encoding_menu](/uploads/c38b4ca9bba937cef5bc2ac5ab825735/xml_default_encoding_menu.png)

Some charset menu items cannot even be displayed because full screen is occupied by previous menu items.

Since Wireshark only implements a small portion of the iana charsets, I think making this list shorter may be more friendly. The idea is to redefine the basic macro about iana charsets in iana_charsets.h for adding a shorter iana enum_val_t array. And that may also simplying other tasks about iana charsets and Wireshark string encoding mappings. After apply this patch, the right-click popup menu of xml 'Default character encoding' preference will look like this:

![xml_default_encoding_menu_short](/uploads/9cd176691ebc75241565c6ec46cb869b/xml_default_encoding_menu_short.png)

# Detail

Redefined the format of the basic macro for creating iana charset enumeration type, enum_val_t or value_string array. That will also maintain the mapping relationship between iana charset and wireshar string encoding.

Introduced a way to create sub sets of value_string or enum_val_t array from the big iana charsets table. The ws_supported_mibenum_vals_character_sets_ev_array is that kind of sub sets enum_val_t array to display enum preference 'Default
character encoding' of xml dissector friendly in right click popup menu.

The mibenum_charset_to_encoding() function is changed to generate mapping code (switch/case) according to the basic macro automatically.

> More details about the basic macro of iana referring to the comments in iana_charsets.h.

notes.body:
BTW, I found some Wireshark encoding in proto.h may correspond to iana charsets that did not conver in mibenum_charset_to_encoding in the past (for example ENC_WINDOWS_1250 and IANA_CS_WINDOWS_1250). But I can't sure which needs to be added to the short enum_val_t array ws_supported_mibenum_vals_character_sets_ev_array.

If someone tells me the list that needs to be add to the ws_supported_mibenum_vals_character_sets_ev_array, I can ammend the git change.

It's true that there are some other encodings that Wireshark does handle that are not in the list (similar to how it wasn't updated with GB18030/GBK when that was added). I think that can be done later.
